opening.argument: The offer is presented as a way to earn Ethereum through spillover, with the creator calling it a passive-income opportunity and saying paid entry can start at just under $100. The speaker also describes upgrading with what was made, while the displayed interface shows numbered paid levels arranged in branching rows of participant slots. Participation is tied to sharing the opportunity with other people, making recruitment and progression through paid tiers central to the proposed benefit. The income disclaimer does not outweigh these direct promotional claims and participation instructions.
